newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Abbey says new year off to positive start.
newsitem.headline: Abbey says new year off to positive start.

text.p: Irish property and development group Abbey Plc said on Friday all its businesses had started the new financial year on a positive note.
"The new year is off to a fair start and all areas of the business are trading profitably," Chairman Charles Gallagher told shareholders at an annual meeting.
Gallagher said the group's UK housebuilding business was enjoying "considerably improved trading conditions".
He said both prices and volumes were up and margins were gradually recovering towards more acceptable levels.
"Our plant hire business is trading successfully in a dull market and will benefit in due course from faster UK growth," Gallagher said in a statement.

He said the group's Irish housing business continued to do well and in the next three months Abbey planned to launch a development in Saggart and Killarney Road, Bray south of Dublin for which the group was seeing "strong early interest".
